designs.name: Videotex Switchboard
designs.tagline: The family's videotex service as a control panel: Home is the map of every page in equal cells, every page is the same rack of cells with its own green screen under its plate, and only the machine gives off green light.
designs.concept: Home is the service's sommaire, laid out as a graphite switchboard. Every page is a cell, and each cell's head is a contents line: lamp, page number, name, dotted leader, count. The line is the key into the page, and the cell below it holds what the page contains now. Every other page opens the same four-column rack. Column 1 holds the plate, then the page's own green screen (the machine's summary of the page), then its tools. The three columns beside it hold one thing to a cell. Because both sides share the same rows, seams meet as modules do in a rack. It should feel like a calm, solid panel where the only light comes from the machine: the tubes, the lamps, the mark and the primary keys.
designs.companions: Graphite and steel make up the body: graphite modules (#121614) on a green-black plate, graphite bezels (#272b2b), plastic keys with a 3px bottom edge, bone ink (#dfe4df) and steel labels (#a9b4af). Brass (#e3cd88) is the service's own voice. It carries the page numbers and the plate codes, the caps of Home, Vera, Status and Settings, and now Family and Memory too, the household's tools in the bar. Low-chroma section colours (heather #bc97e8 Ideas, cornflower #9ccdf8 Plans, sea #83d5d4 To do, rose #eda6c1 Wishes) appear only as a 2px cap, a number, an icon, a kind label and the faint mosaic pictogram. Ochre (#eaa76b) now has a single job: a lamp or cap that means "look at this", plus today (and it remains the restaurant kind's label colour). Outing is a darker, yellower sage (#8d9a5c), so it no longer reads as a done or OK state. Bright #6dff9c belongs to the phosphor: every tube, the radar, her screens, the mark and caret, the primary keys, focus and live lamps. A calmer #92dfa7 marks ticks, done and the box being typed in.
decisions: One grid, a rack. At 1061px and wider, .board > .side and .board > .main are subgrids over the same rows (grid-template-rows: subgrid; .main also takes grid-template-columns: subgrid, and .cells uses display: contents). A row is half a unit. A cell spans two rows, and a key, a strip or a plan spans one. The gap between rows is each cell's own margin, so empty implicit rows take no space, and min-height sits on .cell, not on the tracks. Pages whose main column is one long document (a settings page, the new-idea form) use .main.flow instead: the side stays sticky and the main column runs on at its own length.

Every page gets a green screen directly under its plate: the machine's word on the page, in the .crt > .crt-tube markup with the full kit (three-layer halo, 0.35px blur, scanlines, sheen, vignette, power light, block cursor). Ideas: the radar. Plans: NEXT UP (the first plan large, the next two dim, and the count). Month view: the month summed up and what is on today. To do: DUE NEXT, the three due soonest, then open and undated counts. Status: the spend counter. Settings: HOW IT STANDS. Family: ON THE LIST, counted by role. Wishes: each kid's open count and the countdowns. One idea: its calendar date, who it is for and its lookup state. Memory: REMEMBERED. Each screen is aria-hidden, because every word on it is also in the cells beside it.

Home is filled with what each page holds now, not with the page's lede. 200 Vera holds the three ways to start as numbered graphite keys, each number a small lit keycap (ask.js still finds .starters, and the ?ask= links work without a script). 300 Ideas has LATELY ADDED as a label. 310 Restaurants shows a large Plex Mono count. 400 Plans shows COMING UP, 500 To do the ticks. 600 Wishes has lettered kid tiles and open counts. 800 Family has lettered tiles for everyone. 900 Status has shaped lamp rows: Answering, Telegram and Calendar, derived from the setup steps and the agenda source already in Home's context. 990 Settings lists the part that needs a look with its ochre lamp, then the other parts numbered 991 to 999. Each line is named after its own page, so the map, the key row and the plates agree.

Home's terminal plays power-on (kit E16). It starts 0.3s after the page is up, at 0.05 opacity, and opens out of a bright line in 0.85s, the question last. The motion frames now show the dark glass, the line, and then the picture. Its radar is larger (up to 17.5rem) to fill the glass the starters left.

The panel reaches the pages that were still stacks. Family: one cell per person (lettered tile in the role's colour, name, role tag, how they reach Vera, CHANGE as the foot key), 'Add somebody' as a two-cell module beside the last person, and the three roles as three half cells beneath it as the legend. The long intro sits in a column-1 'Who can get in' cell with an ochre look-lamp line. Wishes: each kid is a half-row contents line ('601 Maya ····· 0 open') over her three list cells, so one kid is one unit, level with the plate and the screen. One idea: a plate with kind tile, #3, title, kind label and status, and EDIT and DROP IT as keys. Its cells are What we know (two wide), On the calendar, The place (two wide), and Plan it and Record how it went as half cells. Memory: a strip for each person a memory is about, then a cell per memory. The remember form sits in column 1, or beside the empty notice when nothing is kept.

One job per light and per colour. The 'you are here' lamp in the key row is gone, because the pressed key with its section-coloured bottom edge already says it. Family and Memory are brass. 310's cap is heather, the Ideas colour, so an ochre cap or lamp always means 'look', or today. Outing moved from #9bcf89 (ΔE 6.6 from lit) to sage #8d9a5c (ΔE 20.8), still 6.2 and 7.6 apart for deuteranopia and protanopia.

Type in steps, used strictly. Things named inside a cell are set at --t-item (19px): idea titles, plan names, task names, people, memories. Contents lines keep --t-cell (23px) and outrank them. Counts, due dates and times are set in Plex Mono with tabular figures. To do shows 'Due Sun 27 Sep · 19:56', formatted from row.due_input by a small Jinja macro (moment). The OPEN tag is hidden when the filter already says Open. Radar brackets stay on one line, and the setup links use text-wrap: pretty.

Controls. The tick is a 26px box with an inset key edge inside a 44px target, and it shows a ghost check in lit green on hover. The six keys carry their page numbers (100 to 600), and Settings reads 991 to 999 on its cards and its nav, so one numbering system teaches itself everywhere. The General settings boxes are flattened into columns with hairlines, the same system as the new-idea form, and 'Who it is for' moved up so the form's second row is whole.

Phone. The six keys are fixed at the foot on Home too. The map runs in page-number order. The pages that only point the way (310, 700, 800, 900, 990) collapse into one-line contents lines, run together as a list. Home dropped from about 3580 to 2970 CSS px. Settings is a contents list, one line and one state per part. Idea pictograms stay clear of the words. The chat plate is one line, and 'Send where I am' sits on the who, mic and Send row as a compact toggle whose words are kept for screen readers. On Home, who, mic and Send share one row.

Fixed outright: the bar pads with 100% rather than 100vw, so the logo, the keys and the panel line up on scrolling pages. The open-fold minus is scoped to details:is(.panel, .fold, .more, .cell)[open], so the Settings menu no longer shows '– ⚙'. The month's name and its Earlier and Later keys sit above the days as a wall calendar has them, and the month spans five rows beside the plate, the screen and the tabs.
designs.measures: 0 hard checks failed; 1 guideline missed: words, worst Home at 32.7% different (was 30.5%; the map now names what is in each page, including Status's lamp rows and Settings' part names). ink_on_bg 15.15:1, brand_on_bg 15.28:1. Green share and hue entropy: home 61.2% / 0.546, ideas 64.8% / 0.514, chat 50.3% / 0.609, status 42.4% / 0.539. Bright green per mille: home 4.4, ideas 12.9, chat 4.0, status 1.65. Kinds ΔE min typical 17.6 (activity~trip), deutan 6.2 (outing~seasonal), protan 7.6 (restaurant~outing). Sections typical 15.7, deutan 5.8, protan 7.9 (the harness measures family as people). Smallest text 12px. No sideways scroll anywhere. Home targets under 44px: 8 of 55. Greeting corner pixel (1150,120): (18,22,20). It now falls in the graphite 300 Ideas cell, since this design has no greeting wash. (100,640) is inside the dark tube glass: (3,8,5). Sheet 135,938 characters; removed.txt is empty.
strengths: One grid rule now holds on every page. The plate, the page's green screen and the tools sit in column 1; the cells sit in columns 2 to 4 on shared rows. Seams meet on Status, To do, Settings, Wishes, Family, one idea and the month, instead of only by luck.

The phosphor is back where the machine speaks, and only there. Every page has a small lit tube under its plate with the whole kit, Home's terminal switches on, the radar is larger, and the keycaps of the ways to start glow. The body stays matte graphite and bone.
Home is a real sommaire. Every cell shows what its page holds now: people, lamps, parts, counts and ways to start. On a phone it becomes a contents list in page-number order.
Colour jobs are clean. Ochre means look or today, brass is the service's voice, section colours are caps only, and outing no longer reads as a done state.

Typesetting in steps. Items at 19px sit under 23px contents lines, figures are in tabular Plex Mono, dates are worded, and one numbering system (100 to 600, 601, 991 to 999, P-codes, #3) runs through the whole app.
weaknesses: Where a page has little data, column 1 now runs longer than the main column: Plans list (6 half-unit plans beside plate, screen, tabs and add), To do (4 tasks beside a tall tools cell) and Family (the long 'Who can get in' cell). The rack leaves honest empty space there.
Some cells stretch to their row and end up mostly empty: the Chat and Status plates, Home's Memory and Wishes cells, the Wishes kid lines in their half rows, and the Family roles row.

Home's view passes only restaurant_count, so 310 shows a count, not the restaurants and their drive times. Status on Home shows Answering, Telegram and Calendar, derived from the setup steps and the agenda source, but not the day's spend. The To do view has no today, so its screen cannot say 'late'. None of these would work without a Python change, so I left them out rather than fake them.

Home's words now differ by 32.7%, up from 30.5%, because the map names each page's contents (lamp rows, the Settings parts). New or changed words elsewhere: the plates' ledes for Plans, 'Who can get in', 'What we know', the screens' words (aria-hidden, so not counted).
The screens repeat what the cells already say, as a summary. They are aria-hidden, so a screen reader hears nothing from them, and some judges may find them redundant.

One idea's title still breaks across lines ('Silver / Falls hike') at the 46px plate step in a 285px column. Setup, Your password and the activity pages are not rebuilt; they pick up the rack from CSS only.
revisions: Rack: .side and .main are subgrids over shared rows at 1061px and wider. Cells span 2 rows and keys and strips span 1, with margins as the seams and min-height on .cell. .main.flow is added for the settings pages and the new-idea form, whose side stays sticky.

A green screen under the plate on Plans (NEXT UP), the month (the month summed up), To do (DUE NEXT), Settings (HOW IT STANDS), Family (ON THE LIST), Wishes, one idea and Memory. Ideas' radar and Status' spend counter were already in that place. Home's terminal has a power-on that the motion frames now show, and a larger radar.

Plans: the lede, a plate key (green 'Put something on the calendar' when the calendar can be written, graphite 'Connect the calendar' for an admin otherwise), and plans as half-unit keys with the date leaf beside the title. Month: the name and Earlier and Later above the days, with the tabs and source in a half cell.

Home: the ways to start moved off the glass into 200 Vera as numbered keys. Lines are renamed after their pages (300 Ideas with LATELY ADDED, 400 Plans with COMING UP, 310 Restaurants, 600 Wishes). Status lamp rows, Settings parts numbered 991 to 999, family tiles, kid tiles, and page-number order. Setup takes two cells in the third row.

Rebuilt on the panel, as new variant templates: family.html, wishes.html, idea.html, memory.html. To do's Add and Filter became one Tools cell (Show and Search side by side). Settings' second cell is a 'Setup' contents line with the parts needing a look.
Colour: the key-row 'you are here' lamp is removed. Family and Memory are brass, 310's cap is heather, and outing is #8d9a5c. The key-row keys carry their page numbers, and Settings reads 991 to 999.

Typesetting: --t-item for idea, plan, task, person and memory names. Mono tabular due dates formatted by a moment() macro. OPEN tag hidden under the Open filter. Brackets nowrap, setup links pretty. The tick is a 26px inset box in a 44px target with a ghost check.

Phone: key row on Home, one-line contents lines on Home and Settings, idea pictograms clear of the text, chat plate on one line, and 'Send where I am' on the Send row. Home's who, mic and Send share one row.
Bar padding uses 100%, and the open-fold minus is scoped. The General boxes are flattened into hairline columns, and 'Who it is for' moved up so the new-idea row is whole.

Declined: a LATE count on To do's screen, and restaurant names with drive times plus a spend line on Home. The views do not pass today's date, the restaurant list or the spend to those templates, and I would not invent them; the screen shows the soonest due and the counts instead. Hiding 200 on the phone: it now holds the ways to start, so it stays, directly under the terminal. A 'Nothing yet' on Home's Memory cell: Home cannot know it, so the cell shows its name and a key. The roles legend went under the Add form as three cells rather than into column 1; it is the legend of the Role box, and in column 1 it made the side far longer than the persons.
crit: Carry the panel onto the pages that are still stacks. Today they show the idea is only paint there. FAMILY (/family): the long intro paragraph floats outside any cell, jammed under the key row. Members are full-width rows, and in 'Add somebody' the ADMIN/PARENT/KID legend starts right under the green ADD key with no space. Make it one cell per person: initial tile, name, role tag, how they reach Vera, and CHANGE as the cell's foot key. Move the intro into a column-1 tools cell ('Who can get in') and the roles legend into another. WISHES (/wishes): 'Maya' and 'Theo' float as pink headings outside the grid, over short cells that are not a full unit. Give each kid a contents-line head ('601 Maya ····· 0 open') over her three list cells, one row per kid. ONE IDEA (/idea/N): it drops the plate for a 2:1 split with a breadcrumb. Put the plate in column 1 (kind tile, #3, title, kind label, EDIT and DROP IT as its keys). Facts, The place, On the calendar, Plan it and Record how it went become cells in columns 2-4. MEMORY: 'Tell Vera something to remember' becomes a column-1 tools cell, and each remembered thing a cell.

Give every page a tube in column 1, directly under its plate. Ideas (radar) and Status (spend) already do this. Make it the rule, and the light comes back where the machine speaks. PLANS: the plate is bare (no lede, no key). Give it its lede and 'Put something on the calendar' as the plate's bright green key, as Ideas has 'Add an idea' and Family has 'Add somebody'. Below that, a NEXT UP readout in the existing .crt > .crt-tube markup: 'PHO OREGON 17:00 [TODAY]', then the next two plans as dim lines. TO DO: a readout such as '2 LATE / 1 THIS WEEK / 1 NO DATE', with the late count in the inverse strength (E15). SETTINGS: the second column-1 cell is a gold sparkle floating over an empty middle with text at the bottom. Make it a contents-line cell, lamp ochre, 'Setup ····· 3', with the three steps listed as on Home. Also give Home's terminal the power-on (kit E16): the motion-on frames show it fully lit from frame 0.

Fill Home's thin cells with what is in the page now, not the page's lede. 200 VERA: move the three ways to start off the glass into this cell as numbered graphite keys (1 / 2 / 3). ask.js finds .starters anywhere in the document, and the ?ask= links work without a script. That fills the emptiest cell, makes the choices legible (they are dim VT323 at about 21px and wrap to two lines now), and cuts about 150px from the terminal, which fills the whole first phone screen. 310 SOMETHING TO EAT: list the two restaurants with their drive time, in the .idea-rows format. 800 FAMILY: four initial tiles (S A M T) with roles. 900 STATUS: three lamp rows (chat on, keys 1 of 3, calendar off), plus '$0.00 of $2.00' in Plex Mono tabular figures. 990 SETTINGS: the part that needs a look, with its ochre lamp. 700 MEMORY: 'Nothing yet' and a key. Name each line after its page, so the map, the key row and the plate agree ('300 Ideas ····· 12' with LATELY ADDED as a label under it; '400 Plans ····· 5' over COMING UP). Dropping the repeated ledes also brings the 30.5% word difference down.

Make the panel one grid, and fix what shears it. The side and main stacks are separate flex columns, so seams meet only by luck. On To do, 'Add something to do' (about 70px) sits beside a 264px task, with the filter hanging below. On Status, the Spending cell runs to 880px beside a row that ends at 540. Make .board > .side and .board > .main subgrids spanning the same rows (grid-template-rows: subgrid; .main also takes grid-template-columns: subgrid, with .cells { display: contents }). Move min-height: var(--cell) from the tracks onto .cell, so row n on the left and on the right share one seam. Size modules in whole and half units, like rack units. To do's Add and Filter become one Tools cell. Plans cells, with the date tile set beside the title as in Home's Coming up, become half-unit keys instead of 264px cells that are 60% empty. Two outright breaks: .bar pads with calc((100vw - var(--page)) / 2 + 1.5rem), so on every page that scrolls the bar sits about 7px right of the key row and the panel (logo at x=56, keys at x=49 on Ideas, To do, Status and Settings); use 100% instead. And sheet.css L663, details[open] > summary::before { content: '–' }, is unscoped, so the open Settings menu shows '– ⚙ Settings ▾'; scope it to details:is(.panel, .fold, .more, .cell)[open].

One job per light and per colour. The bright lamp in .places .key[aria-current='page']::after means 'you are here', while the same lamp on the map means 'live'. Drop it: the pressed key with its section-coloured bottom edge already says 'here'. Light a key's lamp only when something is live, for example the Status key from status_light, which base.html already has. Ochre (--people) does five jobs: restaurant kind, Family, Memory, today, and late or needs-a-look. On Home, the Memory and Family caps look just like the Finish setting up state cap. Set .in-family, .in-memory, .to-family, .to-memory { --sec: var(--accent) }: brass, because they are the service's tools in the bar beside Status and Settings, and they are not in the key row, so the section distance does not apply. Then an ochre cap or lamp always means 'look at this', or today. The outing moss (#9bcf89) is ΔE 6.6 from lit (#92dfa7), so an 'OUTING' label reads like a done or OK state. Move outing towards a darker, yellower sage.

Phone (390). IDEAS: the pictogram (.index .idea-card > .card-art, absolute bottom-right) lies over the facts, with '(estimate)' running under the bike, the fork and the tree. At 640px and below, give .card-main padding-right: 4rem, or move the art to the head row at 2rem. HOME: there is no key row, although every other page has the fixed six keys, so Ideas and Plans are about two screens down. Show .places on Home too. Put the map in page-number order: it now runs 400, 500, setup, 300, 200, 310, 600, which breaks the contents metaphor. Hide 200, since the terminal is Vera. Home's key cells (.key-cell) and Settings' nine 260px cells should become one-line contents lines on the phone (lamp, number, name, leader, state): a true phone sommaire instead of 170px boxes holding one line and a picture. CHAT: the plate takes about 230 CSS px and the composer plus the key row about 280, which leaves about 250px of conversation. Collapse the plate to a single line, and put 'Send where I am' on the From / mic / Send row.

Typesetting. Things named inside a cell are set at the cell-name step: idea card titles and .plan .what { font-size: var(--t-cell) } are 23px, the same size as Home's contents lines. Use your own --t-item (19px), so contents lines outrank items and more names fit on one line. 'Mount St. / Helens day trip' now splits the proper name on Ideas and leaves 'trip' alone on a line on Plans. Set counts, dates and times in Plex Mono with tabular-nums. On To do, 'Due 2026-09-27 19:56' is raw ISO in the body face beside Home's 'was due 2 days ago'; format it from row.due_input as 'Sun 27 Sep · 19:56'. Hide the OPEN tag when the filter already says Open. The 44px empty tick square on To do and Home reads as an image placeholder: draw a 26-28px box with an inset key edge inside the 44px target, and show a ghost check in #92dfa7 on hover. On the radar tube, keep each bracket on one line (white-space: nowrap on '[2 H 45 MIN W]', which now breaks as '[2 / H 45 MIN W]'). Set text-wrap: pretty on the setup links, where 'themselves.' and 'phones.' are left alone on lines. Contents-line numbers could also go on the six keys (::before, as .plate-code does), and Settings' 01-09 could read 991-999, so the one numbering system teaches itself everywhere.

Forms follow one rule. On the new-idea form, row 2 has Kind and Suggested by, and the third cell is a hole. Bring 'Who it is for' up from Everything else so the row is whole. The idea form sets each field as its own cell on the plate, but Settings > General nests three boxes: panel, then a darker bordered field cell, then the input. Flatten the field cells (no border, hairline rules between the columns), or make them top-level cells as on the idea form, so both forms read as the same panel.

designs.name: Evening Listing, Traced
designs.tagline: Evening Listing, Relit with its light put to work: the tube traces the coming weeks, the rails are lit from now, and every band head says one figure.
designs.concept: This refines Evening Listing, Relit. The programme listing on slate stays whole, and the phosphor light now draws data instead of only glowing. Next up's spare glass becomes a four-week trace of the plans. Coming up, To do and Status's Who answers each carry a rail that is lit from now, or between live lamps. A row you point at lights and fades like phosphor. The page stays calm and grounded, with the light where the family's time is.
designs.companions:

decisions: Light as data (soul, style, system, skeptic, feedback). Next up's tube now ends with its content (align-self:start). The next pulse is labelled on the glass in VT323 ('THU 1'), and the day numbers sit under the axis. A 1px sweep with a 26-unit wake runs from y 22 to 52 only, under the labels, so it never crosses a word; each pulse flares as it passes (p0-p9 timing classes). The trace is aria-hidden. On the phone it sits under the words.

Coming up's rail, on Home and on the Plans list (they share the drawing). The NOW lamp is 12px and white-hot (radial hot core into #6dff9c) with E20's 8px/18px halo, breathing every 3.2s. It is the only breathing lamp on Home. The stretch from it to the first stop is a 2px #6dff9c line with the two-layer halo, drawn as a filter drop-shadow so the halo fades with the line into the steel before the stop.

To do, on Home and on its page, becomes a timetable. How I read 'the due column becomes a rail': the rail threads the tick wells themselves, so each checkbox is its own stop, rather than adding dots beside it. The rail runs only through tasks with a deadline, in due order. Late wells are amber rings with no glow, and the 'was due' words stay. A steady lit NOW tick (a 16px hot bar with the lamp halo, and 'NOW' in lit mono caps) sits between the late ones and the rest, and the rail is lit from it to the next well. Status: Who answers is a single-column chain. A steel rail runs through its lamps and is lit 2px (with halo) only between two lamps that are on, then goes steel to the off ring. Keys and Connected to keep their lamps without rails. The 'on' lamps take the white-hot core.

Visible afterglow (all lenses, open three rounds). Pointing at a row lights it in .12s with four things: a 12% steel wash (color-mix #9cc4dc 12% into the zebra), a 2px sage edge, a 0 0 18px -10px sage halo, and, my addition, its dotted leader traced in sage. One control per filter (usability, interaction, skeptic, system). The Kind select is gone (a hidden field keeps the chosen kind when searching). On To do, Search moved into the head column under Open, Done, Cancelled and All, as a field with a magnifier key.

An improvement beyond the brief, because the page called for it. With the filters on one row, the tube beside them left about 150px of dead glass-height, and the rows fell to y=600. So the Ideas scope moved to the foot of the head column, as the list's legend of where: the radar over its words, as long as the kind key above it, with no spare glass. The Ideas head column widens to 13.25rem via main:has(.idea-band), so the page head stays aligned with it.

The head column says only what adds, as one rule on every page (a new `head_figure` macro). Name the facts. Each list whose facts had no labels now has one small-caps column-head row, set in the list's own grid: To do has WHO · DUE; Ideas has KIND · DRIVE · WAY · FOR · #; Lately added has KIND · FOR · # (Home's ideas carry no drive or way, so none is invented; the idea's number was added as a fact so both lists read alike); Restaurants has KIND · FOR · COST; Status's single-column lists have STATE. The fixed sub-columns were converted from ch to rem, so a 12px head and a 15px fact share one width. On the phone the facts fold under the title, so only To do keeps its heads. Coming up's weekday and date are split into fixed sub-columns and right-aligned on the digit, so 1, 4, 9 and 17 line up.

A written six-step scale, one step larger for the family: 12 (caps labels, Plex Mono 500 .05em), 15 (detail, kind words, facts), 17 (body, rows and chat, at 1.55), 21 (band heads, condensed 600), 32 (the question and the head figures), 44 (mastheads). 'Edit, complete, or snooze' became a regular-weight ink-2 pencil 'Edit' at the row's end, a fixed 4.5rem wide, with the rest of the words kept for screen readers. --pad trimmed to 1.1rem keeps Home at 1778px at 1280.

Measure. Status's single-column lists and the Keys board are capped at 44rem, so all their right edges line up and no state sits far from its name. Settings rows are capped at 56rem. I went below the brief's 62rem because at 1280 the band body is already under 62rem, so a 62rem cap would change nothing.

A thinner case (the owner asked twice): a #2e3337 graphite face, 6px wide at a 10px radius. An engraved rim (inset 0 0 0 1px #0009) sits over a 6% top highlight, with a fine groove (dark at 3-4px, light at 4-5px) round the glass. The chin is 14px, with vents and the power LED at full strength, and the 80px spill is kept. The tube is 6px/7px.

Phone: Send stays on the From row. The larger 15px select had pushed it off once the scroll bar showed, so the ask bar's gaps and the select's padding were trimmed.

designs.name: Desk Terminal
designs.tagline: One real terminal stands at the left of the family's desk on every page, the only lit, cased and rounded thing there: the machine states how the page stands and holds its controls; the matte desk beside it holds only the family's rows.
designs.concept: On every page one real terminal stands at the left of the family's desk. It is a graphite body holding the page's one lit tube, its console deck and, where a page has three bands or more, a numbered Contents plate, and it ends in a foot that says how the machine stands. The machine states, the desk holds: the square, matte slate desk carries only the family's one-line rows, so the tube's light (bloom, blur, scanlines, a warm-up from a bright line, glowing lamps) is back at full strength where attention belongs, and the rest of the page is the calmest yet.
designs.companions: Each colour has one job. Steel (#6b8396 with a 2px #9cc4dc cap) marks "here": the bar, the latched key with its lit sage LED, the rings that number the bands and the Contents stops, today on the month, and the family's bubble cap. Denim (#9db6d6) is for links, always underlined and in sentence case. A cobalt wash (#4f60e6 at 2.2) sits at the terminal's top right and samples (34,43,62). Graphite (bezel #2c3135, body #161b1e) is the machine; slate trays (#12181b) under one top rule are the desk. Amber is only words and rings: late, needs a look, setup. Each kind and section keeps its own colour, named in words mixed 72% toward the ink, and the kind bank doubles as the legend. The accent (#82a4b5, a low-chroma steel-cyan) only tints icons on Home, Status and Settings. #6dff9c is kept for the mark, the caret, Send or the page's one primary, "mind", focus, the tubes, the foot's lamp, the NOW lamp and Chat's lit ring.
decisions: Built as a clean sheet by Tuning Dock's method. variants/r12-idea-2/build.py takes today's stylesheet as theme.py themes it for these tokens (so E1-E22 are all present, re-tinted at glow, screenGlow and topGlow 1.0), moves every font size onto the six steps 12/15/17/22/32/40, then appends the design's own palette.css. The sheet is 182,876 characters; 76,255 of them are the design's own.

Own markup in variants/r12-idea-2/templates. base.html sets the frame: the bar, then main holding aside.terminal (blocks tube, deck, contents, foot) and the desk, plus a lower block for bands under both columns. Every page gets the terminal; a page that defines nothing gets the status foot alone.

Bent the brief's accent. #8fb3cf fell to 0.3 dE from the kids' pink (#ff9fd0) under protanopia, and they sit side by side in the bar. A search of steel-cyans found #82a4b5, which clears all three distances (15.1 / 12.0 / 6.1) and sits 15 or more from plans.

Sticky terminal (top: bar plus 0.875rem, max-height: 100dvh minus bar and gaps, scrolls inside) on every page except Home. On Home the terminal is as tall as the three bands beside it (about 930px against the desk's 930px), so it has nothing to slide past; a height cap would only have hidden its foot behind an inner scroll bar.

The deck's banks carry their name at the side, as the box's From does, rather than on a line of their own. That saved about 70px, so the Ideas terminal (radar tube, Search, the two-up Kind bank, For, Status and foot) fits a 900px screen exactly.

Banks of four keys or more go two-up (Kind, Show). Every key is a 44px graphite link that applies at once. The latched key is steel reverse with #0b0e0c words, a 2px #9cc4dc cap and a 5px lit-sage LED.

Home's tube, top to bottom: her screen and 'Tue 29 Sep' dim; her last line as scrollback, which the view shows only while recent, so it is absent in today's demo; the question as the textarea's label at VT323 32px, normal phosphor, with 'mind' at hot core and E1's two halos, then a block cursor that blinks 8 times and stays lit; NEXT UP in inverse, the plan and '4 plans on the radar' beside the radar. The tube keeps .next-up and warms up once from a bright line in 1.15s, starting at 0.05 opacity.

The Contents plate numbers the bands, with dotted leaders to tabular counts, on one thin steel line through the rings. '2 late' is amber words linking to To do's late anchor. The plate's name is set into its frame line. A CSS-only scroll-driven view timeline (timeline-scope on main) latches the entries whose bands are in view in steel; it is static under reduced motion. A Contents link that lands on its band flashes a steel edge (E10 in the desk's colour).

Status foot on every page: one 44px link at 15px holding a breathing lamp (ringed amber or red while something needs an admin), who answers, the spend and 'Status →'. It shows today's spend of the limit on Status, where the page knows it; elsewhere it shows the limit a day, because the harness has no context processor to hand every page the spend.

Desk lamps (Status rows) are flat sage, not glowing, so the desk keeps a single glow, the NOW lamp. Chat's lit ring at the composer is the one other exception, as the brief asked. The live status glow lives in the terminal's foot.

Plans (month) has no list of plans in its view, so its tube traces the days its own grid still shows from today: a pulse on each day with a plan, the next one lit and pinging, and a beam that sweeps the plot band only. The Plans list page has the full four-week trace from upcoming, with the same rail rows as Home.
Home's lower row pairs Lately added (1.4fr) with the kids' wishes, and puts Something to eat under the wishes in column 2, so the two columns end level.

Type: Plex Sans 17/1.55 for text, Plex Sans Condensed 600 for heads (40 page, 32 on the terminal, 22 bands), Plex Mono only for figures and the 12px caps labels (tabular, slashed zero, tracking 0.05em), VT323 only on the glass at its own 20/24/32/52 sizes because its em sets small. No tracked caps on keys or links; balanced heads, pretty paragraphs.

Chat: her screen at 4.5rem on the terminal, with a READY lamp and the kids' conversations as keys. The thread hangs on the desk from a steel track: the day said once where it changes, each time at its own bubble. Hers is on glass with a 30% brand edge; the family's is a square slate bubble with a 3px #9cc4dc cap. The composer sits at the thread's foot behind a lit ring, and on the phone it is pinned above the tab bar at about 165px.
Setup's step rings are drawn smaller (21px, 1px) than the band's ring, so the band's number outranks its steps. Settings rows put each part's state under its name in words, not in mono.

Removed, with reasons in variants/r12-idea-2/removed.txt, written after the final check because the linter found nothing to list: Ideas' Kind and Status selects and their Filter button (now one-tap banks; Search keeps its own submit); the Ideas page's All ideas / Restaurants tabs (the Restaurant key; restaurants still reached from Home); per-band counts in desk heads (moved to the Contents plate); the extra facts on each idea row (one-line rows); the visible 'Edit, complete, or snooze' words (a 44px pencil key, still read out).

strengths: A new family, 8.9 or more from every carried palette. One rule holds on every page: the machine states, the desk holds. The terminal gives each page its one lit tube drawn from live data (Next up with the radar, the Ideas map, To do's late bars, the plan trace, the spend), its controls and its status foot; the desk is square, matte slate.

The CRT soul is back at full strength and scarce: exact #6dff9c at 1.0, VT323 with a 0.35px blur and three halos, scanlines, sheen and falloff, a thin graphite case with an engraved rim, a vented chin and a two-layer power lamp, the 80px spill, a warm-up from a bright line in the motion frames, the question typed on the glass under a blinking cursor with 'mind' lit, and the greeting's pool with masked scanlines rising by Send.

Home's terminal is about 930px tall, so its foot sits below the fold at 1280×900. The Ideas terminal fills the 900px viewport exactly, so a family with more kinds or people would scroll inside it.
The month view's trace draws only the days its grid still shows from today (6 in the demo), so it reads thin; the full four-week trace is on the Plans list, which the render does not shoot.

The Settings overview lists the pages twice: as the bank on the deck, and as rows with their states on the desk.

plan.reading:
After eleven rounds the colour is settled. The four carried palettes have almost the same tokens: a #0b0e0c ground, slate solids at C about 0.015, bone ink near 12.5:1, steel for "here", denim links, amber with one job, and the exact #6dff9c relit at 1.0 on a short list. They differ only in structure, and the panel now scores on three things.
- **Structure that holds on every page.** Evening Listing, Relit has a head column that says how each band stands. Long Persistence has column heads that name every fact.
- **Light that carries data.** Long Persistence's tubes draw the family's weeks. Track Diagram Relit lights the stretch of track from the now lamp to the next stop.
- **Usability floors.** 0 small targets, words in the bar, sentence-case links, one control per filter, and late shown in words.

Evening Listing, Relit leads (8.04, in eight top fours). Its weakest lenses are soul and style, both 7.3. Their reasons, echoed by the skeptic: the listing half is unlit below the fold, it has no signature graphic, Next up leaves empty glass, the row afterglow is still invisible, the steel "here" block is pale, the Ideas kind filter appears twice, and some head summaries repeat their rows. Every lens proposed the same child: that listing, plus Long Persistence's plan trace, Track Diagram Relit's lit track, and Large Setting's larger type scale.

The promise votes point at wild ideas. Flight Console and Videotex already appear twice each this round, and Long Persistence is carried. One wanted idea is missing: the docked terminal column. It was round 10's most-promised idea (7 votes) and the usability and interaction lenses' favourite. It fell three times for the same fixable reasons: indigo keys, tracked-caps "ALL" keys, and a column that did not stick, which left dead black or empty lit glass beside it.

briefs.name: Evening Listing, Traced
briefs.hypothesis:
REFINEMENT of the strongest carried winner, Evening Listing, Relit (r11-idea-1). It scored 8.04 and sat in all eight top fours. It came first with system (8.5), interaction (8.4), type (8.3), usability (8.8) and the skeptic (7.8).

Its losses are narrow, named by five or more lenses, and all fixable without touching the listing:
- Soul and style (both 7.3): the listing half is matte below the fold, apart from a tiny NOW, and the design has no signature graphic.
- System, interaction and skeptic: Next up's tube leaves empty glass.
- All eight lenses: the row afterglow is still invisible, for the third round running.
- Usability, interaction and skeptic: the kind filter appears twice, as a head-column list and a Kind select, and Restaurants appears twice.
- Four lenses: head summaries repeat their rows ('0 open' over two '0 open' rows; 'next in 2 days' echoes the first row). '4 more' does not say 4 of what.
- Skeptic and feedback: the steel 'here' block is pale.
- Feedback: To do, Status and Plans have no lines, and the monitor case is still the owner's 'too dominant pewter slab'.

Every lens's notes asked for the same breed: this listing, Long Persistence's plan trace in the spare glass, Track Diagram Relit's lit stretch of track from the now lamp, and Large Setting's larger written scale.

What should happen:
- The four structural scores should hold, because the listing, the head column, the timetable Chat and the 0 small targets are untouched, and each change is one of those lenses' own fixes.
- Soul and style should rise, because light comes to the listing half as data (a trace, an occupied track, now ticks), not as more glow.
- Feedback should rise with lines on To do and Status and a thinner case.

That should beat the other three carried:
- Long Persistence: its Status tables wrap, and it has no listing.
- Track Diagram Relit: weaker rows, the 'was due' words dropped, and invisible in stills.
- Signal Legend Relit: an olive tray, and a near-duplicate.

It is not this round's phosphor mutant of the same parent. That mutant relights the whole kit and fixes nothing. This child fixes the named faults and adds light only where it draws data.

- The lit track and now lamp: Track Diagram Relit (rounds/r12/variants/r11-mut-4/src/phosphor.css and track.css).

- Lamps: phosphor_kit.md E17 and E20.

KEEP
- the slate bands with the head column inside;
- one-line rows with a leader only where a fact follows, fixed tabular sub-columns, and rows capped at about 62rem;
- condensed Instrument Sans heads, Plex Mono figures with a slashed zero, and denim underlined sentence-case links with arrows;
- words in the bar and the tuning scale under it;
- the timetable Chat: the date once, each time at its bubble, ending in a lit ring at the box;

- the relit phosphor list at glow .9, screenGlow 1.0, topGlow 1.0 and washGlow 2.4 (do not re-run the whole kit; the phosphor mutant does that);
- every token not named below.

CHANGE, most-cited first

1) LIGHT AS DATA BELOW THE FOLD (soul, style, system, skeptic, feedback)

a) Next up:
- The tube ends with its content (align-self:start); the radar stays beside the words.
- The spare glass under the words becomes a plot band holding Long Persistence's trace: one pulse per plan Coming up lists (four weeks at 1 wk/div).
- Pulses rest at .6 opacity or more, 60-70% of the band tall, with a 2px hot core (color-mix(in srgb,var(--screen) 58%,#fff)).
- NOW is a lit line at the left. The next pulse is labelled on the glass in VT323 ('THU 1').
- A 1px sweep runs inside the plot band only, never across a word.
- The trace is aria-hidden; the words carry the meaning.
- On the phone the band sits under the words.

b) Coming up's rail:
- The NOW lamp is white-hot and breathing (E20). It is the only breathing lamp on Home.
- The stretch of rail from NOW to the first stop is lit #6dff9c with the two-layer halo (0 0 4px at 80%, 0 0 12px at 35%), fading to steel before the stop.
- It must be visible at 1x: a 2px line.

c) To do, on Home's band and on its page:
- The due column becomes a timetable rail.
- A steady lit NOW tick (no breathing) sits between the late rows and the rest.
- Late wells are amber rings, not glows, and the 'was due' words stay.

d) Status: Who answers becomes a chain on a rail, lit only between lamps that are on. The other bands keep their lamps without rails.

2) A VISIBLE AFTERGLOW (all lenses, open for three rounds)
- Pointing at a row lights it in .12s: a 12% steel wash (color-mix(in srgb,#9cc4dc 12%,var(--zebra))), a 2px lit sage (#86d9a6) left edge, and a faint halo (0 0 18px -10px of lit).
- It fades over 1.2s ease-out.
- Keep `.idea-card` on the idea rows so motion-glow-1 to 3 in the details strip show the fade.

3) ONE CONTROL PER FILTER (usability, interaction, skeptic, system)
- Ideas: the head column's kind list is the only kind filter. Set it two-up (grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr) in 44px cells, each kind's icon in its colour.
- Drop the Kind select. Status, For and Search stay on one row.
- Restaurants appears once, as the Restaurant key, which leads to the restaurants view. Remove the separate tab and list it in removed.txt.
- To do: move Search into the head column, under Open, Done, Cancelled and All.

4) THE HEAD COLUMN SAYS ONLY WHAT ADDS, AS A RULE (type, system, interaction, skeptic)
- Each band's head gets one tabular figure at the 32px step over a 12px caps label: '4 / PLANS', '4 / OPEN', '12 / IDEAS', '3 ON · 1 OFF'.
- Under it goes at most one state, and it is a link: '2 late' in amber words goes to To do filtered to late.
- Drop 'next in 2 days' and the kids' '0 open'. Say what '4 more' counts.
- On the phone, set the figure and state inline beside the band's title, not as a 230px block.

5) NAME THE FACTS (type, interaction; from Long Persistence)
- Add one small-caps column-head row per band where the facts are unlabelled:
  - To do: WHO · DUE;
  - Lately added and Ideas: KIND · DRIVE · WAY · FOR · #;
  - Status: STATE.
- Coming up needs none.
- Right-align the weekday-date sub-column on the digit, so 1, 4, 9 and 17 line up.

6) A WRITTEN SIX-STEP SCALE, ONE STEP LARGER FOR THE FAMILY (feedback, type; from Large Setting)
- 12px: caps labels, Plex Mono 500 at .05em.
- 15px: detail, kind words and facts, Plex Mono tabular.
- 17px: body, rows and chat, at 1.55.
- 21px: band heads, wdth 80, 600, one line, balanced.
- 32px: the question and the head figures.
- 44px: mastheads.

No sentence is set in mono: 'No active reminder.' goes to the sans. 'Edit, complete, or snooze' becomes a regular-weight ink-2 pencil link at the row's end. Trim --pad so Home stays at about 1800px or less at 1280.

7) 'HERE' ONE STEP QUIETER (skeptic, feedback)
- Steel reverse #6b8396 with #0b0e0c words (4.9:1) and a 2px #9cc4dc cap. Use it in the bar, the tabs, the head-column lists and the phone's tab cell.
- The family's bubble takes the #9cc4dc cap too, so Chat is not 93% green.

8) MEASURE (system, interaction): cap Status and Settings rows at 62rem, so no value sits 700px from its name.

9) A THINNER CASE (feedback; the owner has said it twice)
- Bezel #2e3337, a 6px face at 10px radius.
- A 1px engraved rim (inset 0 0 0 1px #0009 under a 6% top highlight) and a fine inner groove.
- A 14px chin with vents and the power LED.
- Keep the 80px spill and the LED at full strength.

10) THE GREETING'S DATE (soul): set 'TUE 29 SEP' in VT323 at 1.25rem, dim strength (E15) with its halo, since the greeting is glass.

TOKENS: as r11-idea-1, except bezel #2e3337. In css: --rev #6b8396 and --rev-cap #9cc4dc.

START FROM these parents (read their judging in rounds/r10 and rounds/r11 results.json):
- Tuning Dock's clean sheet and dock templates for every page (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r11/variants/r11-wmut-1/: sheet.css and templates/; palette rounds/r11/palettes/r11-wmut-1.json; shots rounds/r11/out/r11-wmut-1/shots/).

- Videotex Sommaire's question on the glass, warm-up, key LED and Contents (rounds/r11/variants/r11-wild-4/templates/_ask.html and home.html).
- All the light from phosphor_kit.md, E1-E22 at full, but only inside the terminal. On a clean sheet, copy the kit's --glow, --afterglow, --shadow, --phosphor*, keyframes and Access blocks.

THE RULE: the machine states, the desk holds. The terminal is the only rounded, cased and lit object on a page. The desk is square, matte and grounded.

LAYOUT, desktop (64rem and up)
- A two-column grid: the terminal at 25-26rem, the desk at 1fr, a 2rem gap.
- The terminal is position:sticky (top: the bar plus 1rem; max-height: calc(100dvh - bar - 2rem); overflow:auto). It is sized to its content, never stretched.
- It spans the desk's first bands. The bands after it run full width under both columns. On Home, Lately added and the kids' wishes run two-up, then Something to eat.
- So no black is left under the terminal in the full-page capture, and none while scrolling.
- Tab order: the terminal first (the ask on Home), then the desk.

THE TERMINAL, top to bottom, the same drawing on every page

1) THE TUBE: only where the page has live data (no glass is lit that is empty).
- The case: a thin graphite case in `bezel` #2c3135, with an 8px face at 12px radius, a 1px engraved rim and a fine inner groove, and an 8% top-edge highlight (E8).
- The chin is 16px, with vent slots and a two-layer power LED (E12), and the case keeps the 80px phosphor spill.
- The glass is E13-E14 whole: VT323 at three strengths, a .35px blur, scanlines 1 in 3, the sheen, and a 60% falloff into the curved corners.
- It warms up once as the page opens, from a bright line, within 1.2s, starting at .05 opacity (E16).
- Tubes by page:
  - Home: Vera's screen and 'TUE 29 SEP' dim at the top; then the question as the tube's prompt ('What's on your mind?', VT323 at about 2.1rem, 'mind' lit with E1, a block cursor blinking 8 times and then lit); then NEXT UP in inverse, the plan and its date, '4 plans on the radar', with the radar at the right (E17). The tube keeps the `.next-up` class.
  - Plans: Next up with a four-week plan trace; the sweep runs only in the plot band under the words, and pulses rest at .6 opacity with a 2px core.
  - Ideas: On the radar, with the nearest and furthest place (keep '[18 MIN NW]' on one line).
  - To do: Blueprint's late-bar tube (late, this week, later, no date, each with its count on the glass).
  - Status: the spend readout.
  - Chat: her screen large (4.5rem presence), with a READY lamp.
  - Settings, Family, Memory: no tube.
  - Sign in and 404: the terminal stands alone, centred at about 30rem, with the face (E22) or the flicker (E18).

2) THE CONSOLE DECK: matte graphite, under the tube. The page's controls live here and nowhere else.
- Home: the ask. The textarea is a real bounded field (#0a0f11, 1px edge, bone ink, phosphor caret, the E4 3px ring plus 22px bloom while typing, a faint resting halo), directly under the glass like a keyboard under a monitor.
  - The question on the glass stays its <label>.
  - From, the mic and Send (the page's one green primary, E3) sit on one row, with Send where I am under it.
  - The ways to start are graphite keys.
  - The greeting's pool (E7), with its masked scanlines, rises inside the terminal from under Send. The cobalt corner wash (#4f60e6 at 2.2) sits at the terminal's top right.
- Ideas: Search (its own submit, for no-JS use), then banks of keys for Kind (two-up, each kind's icon in its colour), For and Status.
- To do: Open, Done, Cancelled and All, plus Search.
- Plans: List and Month, plus Earlier and Later.
- Settings: its sections.
- Every bank key is a 44px link that applies at once (one behaviour everywhere), sentence case, never tracked caps.
- Keys are flat graphite (#1d2327, a #3a434a edge, a 5% top highlight).
- The latched key is steel reverse: #6b8396 with #0b0e0c words (4.9:1), a 2px #9cc4dc cap, and Videotex's LED, a 5px lit-sage dot with a small halo.
- No indigo anywhere.

3) THE CONTENTS PLATE: on Home, and on any page with three or more bands. The counts live here and only here.
- Numbered 44px rows, with dotted leaders to tabular counts, each a link to its band:
  - '1 Finish setting up … 3 steps' first, while it has steps, with an amber ring;
  - '2 Coming up … 4 plans';
  - '3 To do … 4 open · 2 late', with '2 late' in amber words linking to To do filtered to late;
  - '4 Lately added … 12 ideas';
  - '5 The kids' wishes … 0 open'.
- A thin steel line joins the numbered ring stops. This is line art that carries the page's order.
- Optional, in CSS only: view-timeline plus timeline-scope latch the entry of the band in view in steel. It is static under reduced motion.

4) THE STATUS FOOT, on every page: one 44px link. It holds a lamp (READY lit; an amber or red ring while something needs an admin), who answers, today's spend of the limit, and 'Status →'. Plex Sans at 15px with mono figures, never 11px.

THE DESK: matte, square, no glow except the NOW lamp
- Bands sit on slate trays (#12181b), each under one top rule.
- Each band head carries the same numbered steel ring as the Contents, the condensed title and its actions at the right, and no counts. The one ring that is not steel is setup's amber ring.
- Rows are one line: the title, a leader only where a fact follows, and a fixed tabular facts column.
- One small-caps column-head row where facts are unlabelled (WHO · DUE; KIND · DRIVE · FOR · #).
- Coming up runs on a rail from a breathing NOW lamp.
- To do's late rows say 'was due …' in amber, with amber-ring wells.
- The kind is named in its colour, mixed 72% toward ink.
- 'See more' links are denim (#9db6d6), underlined, in sentence case, with an arrow.
- The row afterglow: a 12% steel wash with a 2px lit (#86d9a6) left edge, fading over 1.2s. Keep `.idea-card` on the idea rows.
- Plans' month fits one screen, with weekends shaded and today in steel reverse, not amber.
- Status rows are one line, with the lamp inline before the name, a leader, and the state.

CHAT
- The terminal holds her screen, READY, who answers, and the kids' conversations as links.
- The desk holds the thread, hung from her mark on a steel track: the date once, each time at its bubble.
- The family's bubbles sit at the right in slate with a 3px #9cc4dc cap. Hers sit at the left on glass (#111712) with an edge at a 30% brand mix.
- The thread ends in a lit ring at the composer, which sits at the thread's foot where the eye lands.

PHONE (below 64rem)
- There is no column.
- Home opens with the terminal (the tube with the question and Next up, then the ask), then the desk.
- Other pages open with their title, then one 'Filter' disclosure holding the deck's banks (never 360px of keys before the list), then the tube after the first band where it has data.
- The Chat composer is pinned above the tab bar, 200px at most.
- The Contents plate is left out. The status foot goes at the page's end.
- Words and icons both stay in the bar and in the tab bar.

TYPE
- IBM Plex Sans for text; Plex Sans Condensed 600 for heads (one line, balanced); Plex Mono only for figures and 12px caps labels (tabular, slashed zero); VT323 only on the glass.
- Six steps: 12 / 15 / 17 / 22 / 32 / 40, with body 17/1.55.
- No tracked caps on controls, keys or links.

TOKENS
- Ground and surfaces: bg #0b0e0c, surface #12181b, surface-2 #182024, surface-3 #1e272d, field #0a0f11.
- Lines and edges: line #20272b, line-2 #2c3439, edge #66727a, card-edge #2a3136.
- Words: ink #d4cfc4, ink-2 #b6b1a7, dim #9f9b92, faint #928e85, heading #ebe6da, label #a4b0c2, secondary #b7c1d1.
- Accent #8fb3cf: a low-chroma cyan-steel for the pages with no colour of their own, the owner's period cyan. Check it stays at least 12 apart from plans.
- Green: brand #6dff9c, brand-hover #92ffb8, screen #6dff9c, lit #86d9a6, top-glow #6dff9c.
- Machine and bar: bezel #2c3135, bar #0f1417, bubble #111712, bubble-them #1c252c.
- Wash #4f60e6 with washGlow 2.2.
- Section and kind colours as carried: outing #9fcfb6, ideas #b58cec, plans #70dcf4, todo #f7dc78, people #ffb850, shows #ff9fd0, seasons #ff956c, danger #ff6b6b, on-bright #07130c.
- glow 1.0, screenGlow 1.0, topGlow 1.0, quietFilter true.
- Write `--shadow: 0 0 #0000`, never `none`.

REMOVED (write removed.txt, and say why in your notes)
- Ideas' Kind and Status selects and their Filter button: replaced by one-tap banks. Search keeps its own submit.
- The separate Restaurants tab: it becomes the Restaurant key.

lessons:
## Round 12

Top four by score: r12-idea-2 Desk Terminal 8.34; r12-idea-1 Evening Listing, Traced 8.09; r11-idea-1 Evening Listing, Relit 7.52; r11-idea-2 Long Persistence 7.5.

- WHAT WON. Desk Terminal (8.34, in all 8 top fours, 7 promise votes) is the first entrant the panel called a page template rather than a palette. One cased graphite terminal holds the tube, the latched-key deck, a numbered Contents plate on a ring rail and a lit 'Ready' status foot. A square matte slate desk beside it holds only the family's one-line rows. That turns 'only the machine is rounded' and 'light is information' into layout. Usability gave it 9.0 because every filter on Ideas, To do and Plans is one mechanism: one-tap latched keys with an LED. Traced (8.09) won type (8.0) and was usability's close second (8.8). It had a figure over a small-caps label in every head column ('4 PLANS', '12 IDEAS'), WHO/DUE/STATE column heads, a NOW divider between late and upcoming rows, '2 late' as a link, the Kind select dropped, and lit rails running from the NOW lamp. Both carried parents dropped (8.04 to 7.52, 7.88 to 7.50) because their children or rivals did the same thing better. The skeptic and system judges ask that only one of Relit, Traced and Afterglow be carried: Traced.
- REFINES 'LIGHT AS DATA' (round 11). A lit thing now has to do a job on every page, not only on Home. Desk Terminal's glass draws each page's data: ASCII Late/This week/Later/No date bars on To do, with amber on the phosphor; the spend on Status; a trace on Plans; the radar on Ideas. That beat a brighter lamp (Track Diagram Relit fell 7.52 to 7.05) and beat haze. Afterglow (7.38) put a scanlined green wash under the bar and was called 'a wash in the corner' by four judges; the skeptic gave it 6.0 for lighting the page title, which is not live. The round-11 open problem stays open. Page-scale haze does not register, and neither does row afterglow (the fourth round now). Blank lit glass still costs points everywhere: about 40px on Afterglow's Next up, about 100px on Switchboard's Home tube, and Desk Terminal's roughly 930px Home column. Fixes: size tubes to their content, use position:sticky with max-height calc(100vh - bar) and no inner scroll, and on pages with nothing live (the form, Wishes, Family, Memory) collapse the terminal to its foot.
- TYPING ON THE GLASS. This round confirmed it as the strongest return of the original's soul. Desk Terminal and Switchboard type 'What's on your mind?' on the tube under a block cursor and warm up from a bright line; that is the r11 Videotex device, now without its brown case. It has three costs to fix. (1) The question shrank to a small VT323 line, so Home's largest head became 'Finish setting up'. (2) Desk Terminal's Home box is the smallest of the leaders; make it at least 3 rows, desk-wide, or widen the terminal to about 27-34rem on Home. (3) The typed field reads as a loose form under a tube. Build it into the terminal's own deck (a keyboard ledge, with a green-black glass tint and a lit caret). Keep the family's typed words in Plex, not VT323; usability faulted green VT323 input as display text.
- FAILED REACHES. (1) Videotex Switchboard (7.01, 7 promise, the wild mutant) made Home a sommaire. It was a rack of equal page cells, each headed by a 44px key with lamp, page number, name, leader and count, with pixel pictograms and a per-page green summary screen. The judges called it the best 'where is everything' device yet. It failed on tracked-caps controls ('ADD AN IDEA'), half-empty stretched cells (Memory, Wishes), 46px plate titles wrapping in 285px cells, card lists, brass warmth, no page-key row on Home, and screens that repeat their cells. To try again: grid-auto-rows:min-content with spans, sentence-case keys, one hairline border with the 2px cap on Home cells only, one-line rows to a facts column, 32px plate titles, and setup in the first and widest cell. Also a screen should say what its cells do not (late count, next due, spend). Or graft it into the leader as Home's lower half. (2) Single Quote (6.59, 6 promise) had the round's best typographic device: title, then the section's figure in its colour, then a stacked mono legend ('Ideas 12 / LAST ADDED SUN 27 SEP'). It also had a command path with a blinking cursor, an LED on the current key, a Status lamp row ('6 working 7 off') and a filter-summary chip. It failed on a plum-graphite cast (hue 304), 53 of 59 small Home targets, a second ALT access-key bar row, inline tracked mono caps in rows, a near-title first To do row, a one-sided Chat and no late marking. To try again: neutral graphite, one bar row, a 15px tape step at 44px, and quote the next-due item in the head, not a big row. (3) Metered's needle meter (below) is the third reach.
